population_note: The 2022 census's count of everyone resident in the province.
median_age_note: The 2022 census's median age of the resident population, as the Institute prints it, in whole years.
religion_note: The 2022 census's count of the resident population by religious affiliation, the province's districts added up. 'Pentecostal' is the census's ADEPR, the Association of Pentecostal Churches of Rwanda; 'Protestant' and 'Adventist' are its own separate categories.
ethnicity_note: The 2022 census's count of the resident population by nationality, Rwandan or foreign; the census asks no ethnicity.
